prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Signing in links your pet securely so your desktop companion is never lost or reset."]
1: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Select whether you want to quickly adopt a ready companion or build a custom pet from scratch."]
2: ["Preparing your desktop pet graphics and background engine..."]
3: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click the system tray icon to hide, summon, or open settings for your pet at any time."]
4: ["Cloud auto-sync enabled: your pet profile and items are preserved whenever you log in."]
5: ["Preview Desktop Interactions", "Practice calling and feeding your companion while desktop graphics finish generating.", "Continue to Desktop"]
6: ["Select Your Setup Experience", "Choose Express Adoption (1-minute setup) or Custom Pet Studio (photo generation)."]
7: ["Rendering Your Companion on Desktop..."]
8: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Use system tray controls to interact, customize, or hide your companion anytime."]
9: ["Your pet customization and companion traits are safely recorded for your account."]
